steps_basic.title: Create two backdrops
steps_basic.instruction: Click on the Stage (bottom right), then click Backdrops tab. Create two backdrops: one with big text 'WAIT' and another with 'GO'.
steps_basic.hint: Use the text tool (T) in the backdrop editor to add large text. Make WAIT red and GO green.

steps_basic.title: Start with WAIT backdrop
steps_basic.instruction: Click on the Stage, go to Code tab. Add 'when green flag clicked' and 'switch backdrop to WAIT'.
steps_basic.hint: Make sure you're coding on the STAGE, not a sprite. Look for the stage icon in the bottom right.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]

steps_basic.title: Add random wait time
steps_basic.instruction: After switching to WAIT, add a 'wait' block with 'pick random 1 to 5' seconds inside it.
steps_basic.hint: Control → wait ( ) seconds. Operators → pick random (1) to (5). Drag the pick random INTO the wait block.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds

steps_basic.title: Reset timer and show GO
steps_basic.instruction: Add 'reset timer' from Sensing, then 'switch backdrop to GO'.
steps_basic.hint: Sensing → reset timer. Looks → switch backdrop to [GO].
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_basic.title: Capture reaction time
steps_basic.instruction: Add 'when stage clicked' event. Then add 'say (timer) for 2 seconds' to show your reaction time.
steps_basic.hint: Sensing → timer block goes inside the say block.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
say (timer) for (2) seconds

steps_basic.title: Test your reaction timer
steps_basic.instruction: Click green flag, wait for GO to appear, then click anywhere on the stage. Your reaction time should appear!
steps_basic.hint: Don't click too early! Wait for the backdrop to change to GO first.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
switch backdrop to [GO v]

when stage clicked
say (timer) for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Start with Basic code
steps_standard.instruction: You've unlocked Standard level! You'll add best time tracking and anti-cheat. Make sure Basic works first.
steps_standard.hint: You should have: WAIT/GO backdrops, random wait, timer reset, and click detection.

steps_standard.title: Create bestTime variable
steps_standard.instruction: Make a new variable called 'bestTime' (for all sprites). This will track your fastest reaction time.
steps_standard.hint: Variables → Make a Variable → type 'bestTime' → OK

steps_standard.title: Initialize bestTime
steps_standard.instruction: In the 'when green flag clicked' script, add 'set bestTime to 999' at the very start.
steps_standard.hint: Set it to a high number (999) so any real time will be better.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_standard.title: Create state variable
steps_standard.instruction: Make another variable called 'state'. This tracks whether we're in WAIT or GO phase.
steps_standard.hint: Variables → Make a Variable → type 'state' → OK

steps_standard.title: Set state to WAIT at start
steps_standard.instruction: After setting bestTime, add 'set state to WAIT'. After switching to WAIT backdrop, keep state as WAIT.
steps_standard.hint: The state should match which backdrop is showing.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [state v] to [WAIT]
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_standard.title: Set state to GO when ready
steps_standard.instruction: After 'switch backdrop to GO', add 'set state to GO'.
steps_standard.hint: Now state will be GO when it's time to click!
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [state v] to [WAIT]
switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
reset timer
set [state v] to [GO]
switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_standard.title: Add anti-cheat check
steps_standard.instruction: In 'when stage clicked', add an 'if then else': if state = WAIT, say 'Too early!' and don't record time.
steps_standard.hint: Operators → (state) = [WAIT]. This prevents cheating by clicking early!
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
if <(state) = [WAIT]> then
  say [Too early! Wait for GO!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (timer) for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Update best time
steps_standard.instruction: In the else part (when state = GO), add 'if timer < bestTime then set bestTime to timer'.
steps_standard.hint: This saves your best time! Operators → (timer) < (bestTime)
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when stage clicked
if <(state) = [WAIT]> then
  say [Too early! Wait for GO!] for (2) seconds
else
  say (timer) for (2) seconds
  if <(timer) < (bestTime)> then
    set [bestTime v] to (timer)

steps_standard.title: Show bestTime on stage
steps_standard.instruction: Check the box next to bestTime variable to show it on stage. Test and try to beat your best time!
steps_standard.hint: Click the checkbox in the Variables category to show/hide variables on stage.

steps_advanced.title: Start with Standard code
steps_advanced.instruction: You've unlocked Advanced level! You'll add multiple rounds and calculate average time. Make sure Standard works.
steps_advanced.hint: You should have: WAIT/GO system, state tracking, bestTime, and anti-cheat.

steps_advanced.title: Create round and total variables
steps_advanced.instruction: Make two new variables: 'round' and 'total'. Round tracks which round you're on, total adds up all times.
steps_advanced.hint: Variables → Make a Variable → 'round'. Then make another one → 'total'.

steps_advanced.title: Initialize round and total
steps_advanced.instruction: At the start of 'when green flag clicked', set round to 0 and total to 0.
steps_advanced.hint: Add these right after setting bestTime to 999.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [round v] to (0)
set [total v] to (0)
set [state v] to [WAIT]

steps_advanced.title: Create a 3-round loop
steps_advanced.instruction: Wrap the WAIT → random wait → GO sequence inside a 'repeat 3' loop.
steps_advanced.hint: Control → repeat (3). Put everything from 'switch backdrop to WAIT' to 'switch backdrop to GO' inside.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [round v] to (0)
set [total v] to (0)
repeat (3)
  set [state v] to [WAIT]
  switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
  wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
  reset timer
  set [state v] to [GO]
  switch backdrop to [GO v]

steps_advanced.title: Wait for click before next round
steps_advanced.instruction: After 'switch backdrop to GO', add 'wait until <mouse down?>'. Then change round by 1.
steps_advanced.hint: Sensing → mouse down? Control → wait until. This waits for the player to click before starting next round.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [round v] to (0)
set [total v] to (0)
repeat (3)
  set [state v] to [WAIT]
  switch backdrop to [WAIT v]
  wait (pick random (1) to (5)) seconds
  reset timer
  set [state v] to [GO]
  switch backdrop to [GO v]
  wait until <mouse down?>
  change [round v] by (1)

steps_advanced.title: Capture time and add to total
steps_advanced.instruction: After 'wait until mouse down', add 'change total by (timer)'. This adds the reaction time to total.
steps_advanced.hint: Sensing → timer goes inside the change block.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
wait until <mouse down?>
change [total v] by (timer)
change [round v] by (1)

steps_advanced.title: Calculate and show average
steps_advanced.instruction: After the 'repeat 3' loop ends, create a variable 'average'. Set average to total / 3. Say 'Average: (average)'.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
after the repeat loop:
set [average v] to ((total) / (3))
say (join [Average: ] (average)) for (3) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Optional: Add Restart button
steps_advanced.instruction: Create a sprite button labeled 'Restart'. When clicked, it broadcasts 'RESTART'. Stage receives RESTART and reruns green flag code.
steps_advanced.hint: Create new sprite → paint 'Restart' text. Events → when this sprite clicked → broadcast RESTART. Stage → when I receive RESTART → run the setup again.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
Restart button sprite:
when this sprite clicked
broadcast [RESTART v]

Stage:
when I receive [RESTART v]
set [bestTime v] to (999)
set [round v] to (0)
set [total v] to (0)
...

steps_advanced.title: Test your advanced timer
steps_advanced.instruction: Click green flag. Complete 3 rounds. Check your average time. Try to improve it! Mark Done when it works!
steps_advanced.hint: The game should run 3 rounds automatically, then show your average reaction time.
